Thank you for contributing a preset to the Phonid community! 🎉

- Pattern(s): <!-- e.g., CVCVC, CVCVCVC -->

### Checklist

Please ensure your contribution meets these requirements:

- [ ] File is named `.*.phonidrc.toml` (starts with dot, ends with `.phonidrc.toml`)
- [ ] File is placed in `public_presets/` directory
- [ ] Configuration was generated using `phonid preflight --suggest`
- [ ] All preflight checks pass
- [ ] Commit is signed (GPG/SSH signature)
- [ ] Configuration includes all required preflight assertions
- [ ] No custom modifications beyond what `--suggest` generates
- [ ] Preset serves a distinct use case from existing presets

### Testing

Please confirm you've tested your preset:

- [ ] Ran `phonid preflight --config public_presets/.your-preset-name.phonidrc.toml`
- [ ] All assertions pass
- [ ] Tested encoding/decoding with sample values
- [ ] Verified WASM build works with your preset
